Why Us

Why Robotrick Curricula?

Alignment with Syrian Curriculum

Our unique advantage is tailoring technical content to integrate with physics, mathematics, and science concepts in the official Syrian curriculum for each grade.

Full Age Range Coverage

Carefully designed programs that start from early childhood and progress through to secondary level.

Learning by Doing

Project-Based Learning curricula where students apply what they learn immediately.

From Idea to Launch

Our Methodology

We follow a precise system to ensure the success of the technical experience in your institution through 5 key phases:

  1. 1

    Needs Analysis

    Studying the school's direction, target age groups, and defining required educational objectives.

  2. 2

    Engineering & Logistics Setup

    Assessing current labs or equipping the school with the latest equipment (robots, training kits, 3D printers) with guaranteed maintenance and support.

  3. 3

    Educational Content Engineering

    Building a custom curriculum that links technical tools with theoretical lessons, with clear lesson plans for teachers.

  4. 4

    Training & Qualification

    Intensive training courses for school staff to enable them to deliver the material with high professionalism.

  5. 5

    Implementation & Follow-up

    Field pilot experiments and periodic follow-up to ensure the educational process runs smoothly and the curriculum evolves based on results.

Teaching Staff

Teaching Staff Solutions

We understand the difficulty of finding specialized staff, so we offer two options to ensure continuity of the educational process:

A

Train Your Staff

Training teachers from within your school and turning them into certified technical trainers.

/
B

Dedicated Trainers

We can provide specialized trainers from our team for full supervision of the training material and management of technical labs within your school.
